code='''def transform(grid):
    # Recolor the connected object whose size matches the foreground template.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        v=grid[r][c]
        if v==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==v:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
        comps.append((v,comp))
    # Recolor object with same pixel count as the largest differently-colored template object.
    # In this task template is the color-0 shape; preserve the grid if ambiguous.
    zeros=[len(c) for v,c in comps if v==0]
    if zeros:
      target=max(zeros)
      candidates=[(v,c) for v,c in comps if v!=0 and len(c)==target]
      if candidates:
        v,c=candidates[0]
        out=[row[:] for row in grid]
        for y,x in c: out[y][x]=0
        return out
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
'''
